what_this_proves: The composer-cluster submit selection works end to end on the real page: the runner typed the prompt, clicked arrow_forward Create exactly once, and one new video came back.
attempt_count 1 with retry_count 0 confirms exact-once held through a real submit.
Exactly one new media id appeared against an empty baseline, so attribution was unambiguous and the result was claimed cleanly.
The runtime-contract preflight ran for real on every run.trial call and passed against flow04-composer-cluster-submit-v2.
Measured latency: submit 08:43:45Z, output detected 08:44:17Z, about 32 seconds at 360p / 8s.

measured_defect_still_open.statement: element.click() has no effect on Flow's generation-settings controls. Proven twice: the mode chip did not open or close the popover, and videocam Video did not switch the mode, while the popover stayed open and the chip stayed on Image throughout.
measured_defect_still_open.contrast: The same element.click() DOES work on arrow_forward Create — this run submitted with it, as did the first video on 2026-08-27.
measured_defect_still_open.likely_cause: Those controls carry the class token flow_tab_slider_trigger and appear to listen on pointerdown/mousedown; element.click() dispatches only a click event. Same family as the Lexical composer, which needed real keyboard-equivalent events. NOT yet proven, and the alternative (the component requires a trusted event) has not been ruled out.
measured_defect_still_open.consequence_today: Image to Video must be switched by hand before a run. Once the mode is already Video, ensureFlowVideoMode returns early and the automated path is unaffected.
measured_defect_still_open.cost_of_the_bug: zero credits, both attempts stopped at PRE_SUBMIT with no click on Create

second_thing_the_owner_had_to_set_by_han.why: the attribution rule claims a result only when exactly ONE new media id appears. At x2 Flow would have produced two, the runner would have returned OUTPUT_AMBIGUOUS and claimed neither, and roughly 30 credits would have been spent for a FAILED row.
second_thing_the_owner_had_to_set_by_han.note: This was caught by reading the config chip before launching, not by spending the credits.
